column20: Residual revenue nearly doubles 2025/26->2026/27 (3.84 -> 7.52bn) and grows ~56% further to 2030/31 (FYV), while delivered volumes FELL 25% since 2010 and utilisation ~0.70 -> 0.67: the charge per site rises because the numerator (RIIO-3 capex recovery) grows into a shrinking, flatter-loaded denominator. T-Demand4 per-MWh (large archetype): 9.3 (2025/26) -> 15.2 (2026/27) -> ~22.4 GBP/MWh by 2030/31 central.

The 2026 subsidy is a LEVEL shift, not a driver change: ohne-Zuschuss the archetype pays ~31 EUR/MWh and the draft-2027 subsidy holds ~16 EUR/MWh. Utilisation fell 0.73 -> 0.70 (2015-2025). E2 stays 10-24% of E1 under grandfathering + AgNes successor "similar heights" — the E1/E2 wedge (borne by others) widens with E1.

The regulated T&D price is flat-to-down (P4), demand grows 5-6%/yr and utilisation is high and stable — the network denominator GROWS with the numerator. Chinese network cost growth lands in the 系统运行费 (capacity + mechanism costs), quadrupling 2023->2026H1 but still only ~87 CNY/MWh (~USD 12).
